claimant_position.speaker: Gil Marer
claimant_position.statement_en: Gil Marer expressly alleges that 100% — not a lesser percentage — of the present assets, annual income, commercial relationships, reputational and institutional influence, investor and capital-market access, fundraising capacity, tax-incentive investment capacity and other economic advantages of the Acosta Matos / RICPE-linked perimeter are directly or indirectly illicit fruits, substitutes or downstream benefits of the staged patrimonial displacement and exploitation of the Aweswell / LPB / Matkator / Sun Park business platform from 2018 onward.
claimant_position.statement_es: Gil Marer alega expresamente que el 100 % —y no un porcentaje inferior— de los activos actuales, ingresos anuales, relaciones comerciales, influencia reputacional e institucional, acceso a inversores y mercados de capitales, capacidad de captación, capacidad de inversión mediante incentivos fiscales y demás ventajas económicas del perímetro vinculado a Acosta Matos / RICPE son, directa o indirectamente, frutos, sustitutos o beneficios posteriores ilícitos del desplazamiento patrimonial por etapas y de la explotación de la plataforma empresarial Aweswell / LPB / Matkator / Sun Park desde 2018.
claimant_position.interpretation_rule: The 100% figure is the reporting party's controlling causal/provenance allegation. It is not a model-generated probability, accounting ratio, adjudicated tracing result or quantified recovery entitlement.

source_supported_anchors.event: CAM acquires the Promontoria/PH122 credit position and begins accumulating creditor/title/Community-related capacity.
Material access/control regime changes at Sun Park; contemporaneous/witness records describe locks, chains, security, exclusion and subsequent customer/payment-history information collection.
Preserved Acosta Matos tourism-page capture lists 'Hotel Lava Verde', Calle Janubio 3, Playa Blanca, among 'Hoteles propios'.

Pilot-room / whole-hotel refurbishment development precedes 2022 adjudication. February 2020 direct supplier emails state a pilot had already been manufactured/installed at the establishment known as Lava Verde; a June 2020 contemporaneous client memo records a prior CAM/Meeting Point whole-hotel refurbishment visit and four pilots.
RICPE webinar places Sun Park / former Aparthotel Sun Park into the Acosta Matos tourism-project portfolio with an approximately €12m investment presentation and a regulated RIC-capital context.
Canarian Hospitality launches as a new hotel-management platform with Acosta Matos strategic/financial backing and begins rapid scale-up.
Hotel New Trend incorporated with minimal initial capital before later economic-unit segregation.
Sun Park economic unit formally segregated to HNT and MYND Yaiza opens; later financing, RIC materialisation, regional incentives and other public-support layers become visible.
Acosta-Matos-linked hospitality/investment ecosystem expands rapidly in managed hotels, rooms, employment, turnover, investment portfolio, brands and projects.

evidential_boundaries: The current corpus does not prove that Acosta Matos or CAM was insolvent, distressed or unable to finance itself in 2017-2018. Gil Marer believes its financial condition was weak; that proposition remains to be tested from filed accounts, liquidity, bank facilities, debt maturity, creditor ageing, cash flow and net assets.

The current corpus does not prove a 100% but-for causal chain from Sun Park to every later asset, euro of income, business relationship, investor contact, public relationship, professional mandate or item of influence.
Pre-2022 commercialisation and development are materially supported; later 2022 adjudication is not treated as the start of economic use.
Ownership, management, construction, investment, RICPE finance, brand, public subsidy and professional advice are distinct legal/economic roles.
RIC, RICPE capital, regional incentives, ordinary debt, private co-investment and EU/FEDER funds remain separate lanes until transaction-level tracing proves overlap.
No employee, investor, adviser, authority, hotel brand or other third party becomes culpable merely because the later platform used or benefited from their relationship.
A whole-wealth recovery investigation is not a finding that every later asset is proprietary property of Aweswell or currently confiscable.

financial_condition_gap_2017_2018.allegation: Gil Marer believes the Acosta Matos business was not in good financial shape in 2017-2018 and did not possess anything comparable to its present hospitality/investment platform.
financial_condition_gap_2017_2018.supported_now: The source record supports a materially smaller hotel/investment footprint before the 2018-2021 expansion and the non-existence of Canarian Hospitality before 2021.
financial_condition_gap_2017_2018.not_supported_yet: A definitive balance-sheet/liquidity/distress conclusion for CAM/Acosta Matos in 2017-2018.

pre_adjudication_commercialisation_rule: For future analysis and communications, do not describe 2022 adjudication as the beginning of Acosta-Matos commercial use of Sun Park. The controlled record contains material 2018 access/control, 2019 Lava Verde self-presentation, 2019-2020 pilots/refurbishment activity, 2020 whole-hotel commercial/project discussions and 2020 RICPE investor presentation before formal HNT segregation/adjudication.

standing_communications_rule.requirement: Every material communication must contain a concise past-present-future context paragraph before the recipient-specific request.
elements: past: original Aweswell/LPB/Matkator integrated platform and 2017-2018 displacement/control allegation
bridge: pre-2022 commercialisation, pilots, operator/investor/fundraising use and later RICPE/HNT/MYND formalisation
present: current scale in hotels, rooms, jobs, turnover, RICPE/investment/public-support interfaces and resulting economic embeddedness/moral-hazard risk
future: request for independent verification, preservation, competence and time-bound institutional handling
standing_communications_rule.boundary: Where the 100% provenance position is relevant, preserve it expressly as Gil Marer's allegation and immediately state that individual causal links and legal recoverability remain to be proved.
